title: iLang skills and plugins for OpenClaw, Hermes and other AI agents
description: Ten instruction-only skills and two OpenClaw plugins written in the iLang protocol. The skills are plain text with no dependencies and work in any agent that loads a SKILL.md: text de-AI rewriting in four languages, Chinese public-account writing, dead-site recovery, prompt rewriting and compression, product research and SEO automation for cross-border sellers, and a US class-action settlement tracker. The plugins register tools and hooks inside the OpenClaw runtime.
